headline: H.J.Res. 46 would have ended the national emergency the President declared on February 15, 2019, related to the U.S.-Mexico border.
what_it_does: If adopted, this joint resolution would have terminated the national emergency declared by the President on February 15, 2019, concerning the U.S.-Mexico border. The official summary does not describe other details of the measure. Congress passed the resolution, but the President vetoed it, and the House did not override the veto on March 26, 2019.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that rely on the February 15, 2019 national emergency declaration
who_it_affects.how: They would have lost the emergency authority that the declaration provided, based on the measure's stated effect of ending the emergency.
